findings.suggestion: Use actual headings when they aid navigation; keep compact labels in forms and reference lists.
findings.why: Repeated bold labels may make navigation harder than real headings.
findings.fix: Consider semantic headings where readers need navigation.
findings.keep_when: Keep compact labels in forms, reference lists and venue-required layouts.

findings.suggestion: Check whether connected prose would clarify relationships; retain procedures and factual lists.
findings.why: Many full-sentence list items may hide how the claims connect.
findings.fix: Use prose when relationships matter more than parallel scanning.
findings.keep_when: Keep procedures, factual lists and accessible reference material.
